id.description: A unique identifying number for the layer. For point cloud scene layer, only a single layer is supported, therefore, id is always 0.

layerType.description: String indicating the layer typeMust be: `PointCloud`

copyrightText.description: Copyright information to be displayed with this layer.

capabilities.description: Capabilities supported by this layer. Possible values for each array string: `View`: View is supported. `Query`: Query is supported. `Extract`: Extract is defined.

spatialReference.description: An object containing the WKID or WKT identifying the spatial reference of the layer's geometry.

heightModelInfo.description: An object containing the vertical coordinate system information.

serviceUpdateTimeStamp.description: Object to provide time stamp when the I3S service or the source of the service was created or updated.

attributeStorageInfo.description: List of attributes included for this layer.
